# PlaywrightEx v0.7.1 - Table of Contents

> Elixir client for the Playwright node.js driver.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [PlaywrightEx](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.md): Main entry point. Elixir client for the Playwright node.js driver.
- [PlaywrightEx.Selector](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.Selector.md): Playright supports different types of locators: CSS, XPath, internal.

- Channels
  - [PlaywrightEx.Browser](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.Browser.md): Interact with a Playwright `Browser`.
  - [PlaywrightEx.BrowserContext](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.BrowserContext.md): Interact with a Playwright `BrowserContext`.
  - [PlaywrightEx.BrowserType](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.BrowserType.md): Interact with a Playwright `BrowserType`.
  - [PlaywrightEx.Dialog](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.Dialog.md): Interact with a Playwright `Dialog`.
  - [PlaywrightEx.Frame](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.Frame.md): Interact with a Playwright `Frame` (usually the "main" frame of a browser page).
  - [PlaywrightEx.Page](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.Page.md): Interact with a Playwright `Page`.
  - [PlaywrightEx.Tracing](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.Tracing.md): Interact with a Playwright `Tracing`.

- Other
  - [PlaywrightEx.Artifact](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.Artifact.md): Interact with a Playwright `Artifact`.
  - [PlaywrightEx.JsLogger](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.JsLogger.md): Behaviour for custom Javascript loggers.

  - [PlaywrightEx.Supervisor](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/PlaywrightEx.Supervisor.md): Playwright connection supervision tree.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix playwright_ex.test.websocket](https://playwright-ex.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PlaywrightEx.Test.Websocket.md): Runs the test suite against a Playwright server running in a Docker container,
connected via websocket transport.
